StyleBase.description: The descriptive base type for both style guideline records, and recipe style provisions. Provides unique properties to identify individual styles

category.description: Name of the category the style belongs to in its style guide.

category_number.description: Number of the category the style belongs to in its style guide.

style_letter.description: The letter identifying the style within its category, as BJCP guidelines use.

style_guide.description: The style guide the style is defined by, such as BJCP 2021 or Brewers Association 2017.

StyleType.description: StyleType provide information for Style categorization

notes.description: Free text notes about the style.

aroma.description: The aroma a beer in this style should present.

appearance.description: The appearance a beer in this style should present.

flavor.description: The flavour a beer in this style should present.

mouthfeel.description: The mouthfeel a beer in this style should present.

overall_impression.description: A summary of the overall character of the style.

ingredients.description: The ingredients characteristic of the style.

RecipeStyleType.description: RecipeStyleType defines style information stored in a recipe record

StyleCategories.description: The kind of beverage a style describes.
